sources.role: config format, save/state naming, input profiles, built-in PIF ROM
platform support: Windows exe, macOS aarch64 bundle + Homebrew cask, Linux binary + Flatpak io.github.gopher64.gopher64, Android
portable.txt beside the executable switches to portable_data/
dirs crate 7.0 per-platform config/data directory resolution (Cargo.toml pins dirs = "7.0")

paths.path: ~/.config/gopher64/config.json (or $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/gopher64/); portable.txt next to the executable switches config to <exe dir>/portable_data/config. Config is a single JSON document written by serde_json (pretty). Controller configuration lives inside it under the "input" key: "input_profiles" is a map of profile name -> {"inputs": [[binding, binding] x 19 logical N64 inputs (dpad, start, Z, A/B/C-buttons/triggers, analog axis, hotkey)], "dinput": bool, "deadzone": int} where each binding is null or {"Key":{"id":N}} (keyboard), {"ControllerButton":{"id":N}}, {"ControllerAxis":{"id","axis","initial_state"}} (SDL3 gamepad), or {"JoystickButton"}/{"JoystickHat"}/{"JoystickAxis"} (raw joystick); "input_profile_binding" [4] names the profile per player port (a "default" profile with SDL3 keyboard + Xbox-style gamepad defaults is created on first run and cannot be deleted); "controller_assignment" [4], "controller_enabled" [4], "transfer_pak" [4], "gb_rom_path"/"gb_ram_path" [4]. cheats.json and retroachievements.json sit beside config.json

paths.naming: <name>-<sha256>.eep | .sra | .fla | .mpk for EEPROM/SRAM/FlashRAM/Controller-Pak, plus .img (Transfer-Pak SD card) and .romsave (homebrew 64 saves); <name> is the sanitized internal header name (bytes 0x20..0x34, non [a-zA-Z0-9_ -] stripped) or the 3-char game id (bytes 0x3B..0x3E, "UNK" fallback); <sha256> is the full uppercase SHA-256 of the ROM (calculate_hash)

paths.path: None required. The PIF ROM is compiled in: src/device/pif/rom.rs holds NTSC_PIF_ROM and PAL_PIF_ROM (1984-byte constants) and device/pif::init selects NTSC vs PAL from the ROM region, so no user firmware is consumed

source:src/device/pif/rom.rs pub const NTSC_PIF_ROM / PAL_PIF_ROM [u8; 1984] @0bb9fbba6
db:firmware_rules has no rows for any N64 emulator; gopher64 correctly needs none (gap note: none to add for carts)

linux.notes: Flatpak io.github.gopher64.gopher64 redirects these directories into ~/.var/app/io.github.gopher64.gopher64/ and needs --filesystem=host:ro to open ROMs outside the sandbox (README). Lunchbox launches with a private data root; native saves/states stay in the directories above unless portable mode is used.
